active_params_definition: Backbone per-token compute parameters: all attention (including the delta v1.5 Mla indexer and the SWA branch, whose dedicated MLA K/V projections are per-token compute; the KDA window adds no matrix parameters because it shares the delta-rule q/k/v) + dense layer-0 MLP + per LatentMoE layer (latent projections, router, top-2 routed experts, all shared experts) + norms and AttnRes. Excludes the tied embedding (a lookup, not per-token compute), the ViT (active on image tokens only) and the MTP auxiliary head (training-only, dropped at inference).
deviations: This file is the ARCHITECTURE arm of the verification leg's internal A/B (docs/specs/VERIFICATION-LEG.ru.md, section 'Метрика и эталон' (i)): the same L3 skeleton scaled to GPT-2-class width — 12 layers x 12 heads x d_model 768 (head_dim 64, kda_dk = kda_dv = 64, mla_head_dim = 64), mlp_intermediate 3072 = 4 x 768 — with the pilot's layer composition scaled by the declared 3:1 ratio (9 KDA + 3 MLA, i.e. three whole [K,K,K,M] units). It is the derivation of net/config.json by values only: no structure and no net/*.py code changed, and the schema invariants (num_heads * head_dim == hidden, kda_dk == kda_dv == head_dim, mla_head_dim == head_dim, the dense-standard prefix is 0 and the KDA/MLA tail is 12, num_layers % 4 == 0) hold, verified by net.config.validate_config. Layer modes are trimmed to the 3 MLA layers actually present (['full', 'reindex', 'reindex'], the ADR-012 layout preserved with the pool builder first).

The A/B partner is net/config-dense124m.json (same width/depth, all 12 layers of the diagnostic dense-standard type: dense attention through the existing oracle net/mla.py:_dense_apply + a dense SiTU-GLU MLP, no KDA recurrence and no LatentMoE). The delta between the two BPB curves is the measured price of the KDA/MLA + LatentMoE architecture at equal width and equal token budget; the task of separating pipeline bugs from that price belongs to the dense arm alone (VERIFICATION-LEG.ru.md, criteria 1-2).

attn_dense_reference = true selects the dense *attention oracle* (dense MLA instead of the sparse+window path, and no KDA window branch) so that the A/B differs in the layer composition and channel mixing only, not in the attention selection mechanism. This does NOT turn the backbone into a dense GPT-2 transformer: the 9 KDA layers remain delta-rule recurrent, the 3 MLA layers remain gated MLA with their latent projection, and the Stable LatentMoE channel mixing stays (1 dense + 11 LatentMoE). The pool declaration (mla_pool_size = 16, modes full/reindex/reindex, mla_block_merge enabled) is therefore inert under the dense oracle, exactly as it is in the pilot config, and is kept declaratively so a sparse-arm rerun needs no file edit.

attnres_block_size = 6 is S = L/N for the 12-layer depth (N = attnres_blocks = 2). The field is declarative metadata: net/attnres.py integrates the full form over all prior deltas and does not consume the block size (MODEL-L3-SKELETON.md section 1 keeps the full form for L < 100), so the value documents the intended layout rather than driving code.

actual_param_count = 353,971,849 and active_params_per_token = 100,483,068 are measured for THIS config with net.model.param_count / active_param_count (shape-only, jax.eval_shape), and both are guarded by tools/tests/test_config_arch124m.py. The total exceeds classical GPT-2 124M (50K vocab) for two declared reasons: the 160K tokenizer vocabulary (embedding 160000 x 768 = 122.9M vs GPT-2's 38.4M) and the skeleton's extra machinery (KDA/MLA projections, AttnRes over all layers, LatentMoE experts, ViT, MTP). The comparison with GPT-2 124M is by BPB, not by parameter count (VERIFICATION-LEG.ru.md, 'Метрика и эталон').

Parameter counts are inherited qualitatively from the skeleton's deviations (net/config.json): LatentMoE expert counts are ours (12 routed + 2 shared, top-2, latent 768, expert intermediate 384); QB is our differentiable monitoring term; AttnRes is additive; mla_top_k = 512 / indexer sizes are scaled down from the source's 64 Q-heads to 12; the hierarchical pool and block merging are ADR-012 / ADR-018 mechanisms, declared here for completeness and inert under the dense oracle. See net/config.json for the full list and the sources.
